# GSAP landing animation runtime

GSAP and ScrollTrigger 3.12.5 are the versions used by the original project. They are served locally so animation does not depend on a CDN during a presentation. Upstream copyright and license headers are retained in each file.

Sources:
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/gsap.min.js
- https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/gsap/3.12.5/ScrollTrigger.min.js

Documentation: https://gsap.com/docs/v3/
